p.s: I agree with this statement especially when we talk about small shop in the center of a big town.
These shops are usually very crowded and you have to wait for a very long time to buy one kilogram of carrots for example.
In such a shops there is usually one or one or two sellers, what is not enough when a shop is full of people.
That's a place where you lose too much of time and health.
Shopping is more enjoyable if you go to a big supermarket, because there is smaller crowd and more sellers work there.
In these days people prefere shopping at supermarkets than at shops or even shopping areas, because shopping at shop is less enjoyable and you spent the same amount of money.
